from pixeltable.functions.huggingface import sentence_transformer

# Get the handle to the existing "docs" table
t = pxt.get_table('docs')

# Bind the embedding UDF to the required model
embedding_fn = sentence_transformer.using(model_id='all-MiniLM-L6-v2')

# Create the embedding index needed for nearest-neighbor lookups on "content"
t.add_embedding_index('content', embedding=embedding_fn)

# Nearest-neighbor query: 5 rows closest to "climate change policy", closest first
sim = t.content.similarity(string='climate change policy')
results = t.select(t.content, sim).order_by(sim, asc=False).limit(5).collect()

print(results)

import pixeltable as pxt
from pixeltable.functions.huggingface import sentence_transformer

# Get the handle to the existing "docs" table
t = pxt.get_table('docs')

# Bind the embedding UDF to the required model
embedding_fn = sentence_transformer.using(model_id='all-MiniLM-L6-v2')

# Create the embedding index needed for nearest-neighbor lookups on "content"
t.add_embedding_index('content', embedding=embedding_fn)

# Nearest-neighbor query: 5 rows closest to "climate change policy", closest first
sim = t.content.similarity(string='climate change policy')
results = t.select(t.content, sim).order_by(sim, asc=False).limit(5).collect()

print(results)
